name: Bangladeshi Banknote (Serial Number Recognition)
description: A computer vision benchmark dataset of 450 Bangladeshi banknote images captured under diverse real-world conditions for banknote serial number detection and optical character recognition. Images were photographed with an 8-megapixel smartphone camera across 100, 200, 500, and 1000 Taka notes collected from personal circulation, banks, and retail vendors, incorporating variations in lighting, folds, stains, and perspective.

provenance.collection_method: Banknotes collected from personal contacts, retail stores, and banking institutions. Captured using an 8-megapixel smartphone camera.
provenance.curation_notes: Focused specifically on banknote serial number detection and alphanumeric character recognition across multiple denominations. Does not contain counterfeit authentication labels.
